svg.title: What the storyteller receives
svg.desc: Unmodified threat wealth stays at 100,000. The biome-only input stays near 77,460. With both source balances subtracted, adjusted threat wealth falls to about 59,708, then returns to the biome-only level by day 22.
svg.text: Fixed example: 100,000 threat wealth; temperate-swamp biome weight 0.6; exponent 0.5.
